name: 荊棘衝鋒獸
prompt: Production animation sheet for EXACT character in reference. EIGHT equally spaced columns and 6 rows, 48 full-body drawings. Wide landscape sheet, maximum resolution. Column directions FIXED in every row: 1 FRONT; 2 FRONT RIGHT; 3 RIGHT PROFILE; 4 BACK RIGHT; 5 BACK; 6 BACK LEFT; 7 LEFT PROFILE; 8 FRONT LEFT. Columns6,7,8 noses point SCREEN LEFT. Back shows back, no face. Same creature identity, anatomy, colors and equipment in ALL views, never mirror handedness. Six DISTINCT locomotion cycle phases, alternating footsteps with bent joints, plant root steps or natural quadruped trot appropriate to anatomy. No extra limbs. Natural proportion muscular quadruped wild boar monster, woody tusks, dense thorn ridges growing along spine, mossy dark green bristles, glowing green eyes; four jointed legs with upper/lower segments. Detailed Japanese manga dark fantasy JRPG monster illustration, fine variable-weight ink lines, cel-shaded shadows plus subtle gradients and highlights, consistent upper-left light. Normal adult proportions or natural creature anatomy, not chibi, no cute face, no smile. Corrupted ancient forest palette: dark/moss green, bark brown, poison purple; yellow-green or teal emissive details. Entire character and appendages visible. Real transparent background alpha=0, absolutely no paper/backdrop/ground shadow or broad ambient glow. Identical camera scale across every frame including collapsed ones. All feet/tails/weapons fit INSIDE each cell with at least 12% empty gutters on ALL sides. No grid or labels. NO overlapping neighbors; no clipping. Return a clean RGBA sprite sheet.
